narration: The bedroll cloth deadens your first step, but the roof is laid to betray weight, not footwear: gravel shifts under the boards and clicks against a glass channel hidden in the wall. Your slow pace gives you a chance to cross between its pulses. A clean passage would reach the guard post unseen; a loud one will ring the toll bell for whoever waits beyond. Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, DC 13—the improvised wraps have lowered the usual difficulty.

ruling.understoodAction: Muffle the loose-gravel alarm with strips cut from the bedroll and cross cautiously.
ruling.ruling: The idea helps but cannot bypass a pressure channel built under the whole passage; it lowers the Stealth DC from 15 to 13.
ruling.stakes: Success reaches the next section unseen; failure rings the toll bell and gives the guards the initiative.
